answer: Each identity posts a stake bond before it earns anything. A duplicate submission forfeits that bond, so every copy is a sunk cost instead of a spare key. Jurors sit in a harbor of established identities, and none may audit its own recruit, so a farm cannot grade itself. The violet badge of a clean history is earned, never transferred. Running 1,000 puppets means locking 1,000 bonds on a karst that erodes with each duplicate.
